source_policy: 2020–2024 annual per-year archive; 2025+ recent complete window preferred, otherwise explicit single-source fallback. No event-window stitching or interpolation.

definitions.fair: Exact M1 bid close immediately before release
definitions.first_close: Fixed first release-aligned M1 bid close
definitions.atr: Mean 14 pre-release M1 true ranges from 15 consecutive pre-release candles
definitions.horizons: Completed M1 bar at release+(horizon-1) minutes; initial jump excluded
definitions.common_impulse: abs(first_close-fair)>=pre-release ATR and close in directional outer25% of fixed first-minute range

limitations: Descriptive M1 bid-price increments, not executable trading returns, not a 70% win-rate claim.
No spread, slippage, fees, stops, targets or trade entry logic are applied here; native strategy results are separate.
The last-two-year evaluation is retrospective, not untouched data.
Missing newest CPI price windows remain missing; scheduled events and observed events are reported separately.
Direction is inferred only from the fixed first-minute price reaction, not from actual-minus-consensus surprises.
Any cross-archive differences are disclosed, not silently overwritten.
